title.zh: Character.AI申请破产后迪士尼同意聘用其多数员工并收购部分资产
title.en: Character.AI申请破产：创始人回归谷歌、CEO转投迪士尼，平台面临关停

current_state.zh: Character.AI破产出售程序推进中：迪士尼拟以2000万美元获得部分技术/专利的永久非独占许可，并以约1.8亿美元三年成本接收66名员工；公司申请破产时仅剩18名全职员工，40名州总检察长介入保护用户聊天记录，11月20日为竞购截止日，若无人接盘平台将关闭。
current_state.en: Character.AI’s bankruptcy sale process is advancing: Disney is poised to pay $20 million for perpetual non-exclusive rights to some technology and patents and to hire 66 employees at an expected cost of about $180 million over three years; the company had only 18 full-time staff at filing, 40 state attorneys general intervened to protect user chat records, and November 20 is the bid deadline, with shutdown possible if no buyer keeps the platform running.

updates.title_zh: 成立仅5年，交互式聊天机器人平台Character.AI申请破产
updates.title_en: Just 5 years in, interactive chatbot platform Character.AI files for bankruptcy
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增：公司预计在11月底至12月初完成出售；平台目前尚未关停，并称若找不到愿意继续运营的买家将停止服务；前CEO Karandeep Anand已于10月2日加入迪士尼任CTO，部分技术员工随之转投，并在出售期间暂时帮助维持平台运营。
updates.what_changed_en: Added: the company expects to complete the sale between late November and early December; the platform has not yet shut down and will stop if no buyer willing to keep operating it is found; former CEO Karandeep Anand joined Disney as CTO on October 2, with some technical staff moving with him and temporarily helping keep the platform running during the sale.
updates.current_state_zh: Character.AI 于10月12日申请 Chapter 11 破产保护，迪士尼提出2000万美元初始报价，仅涉及部分知识产权的永久非独家授权而非平台本身；平台尚未关停，公司预计11月底至12月初完成出售，若找不到愿意继续运营的买家将停止服务。
updates.current_state_en: Character.AI filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection on October 12, with Disney submitting a $20 million initial bid covering only perpetual non-exclusive licensing of some IP rather than the platform itself. The platform has not yet shut down, the company expects to complete the sale between late November and early December, and it will stop service if no buyer willing to keep operating it is found.
updates.detailed_summary_zh:
上线约五年后，Character.AI于10月12日在美国申请Chapter 11破产保护，迪士尼对其部分资产提出2000万美元的初始报价。公司预计在11月底至12月初完成出售。

平台目前尚未关停，但公司表示如果找不到愿意继续运营的买家，服务就会停止；已有用户开始询问如何保存自己与AI角色持续数年的聊天记录。

迪士尼的初始报价只涉及Character.AI部分知识产权的永久非独家授权等权益，并未承诺接手整个平台。Character.AI前CEO Karandeep Anand已于10月2日加入迪士尼出任首席技术官，部分技术员工也随之转投迪士尼，这些离职员工正帮助平台在出售期间短暂维持运营。
updates.detailed_summary_en:
Character.AI filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in the United States on October 12, roughly five years after launch, and Disney has submitted a $20 million initial bid for some of its assets. The company expects to complete the sale between late November and early December.

The platform has not shut down yet, but the company says it will stop service if no buyer is found to keep operating it, and users have already begun asking how to preserve chat histories with their AI characters that span several years.

Disney's initial offer covers only a perpetual, non-exclusive license to some of Character.AI's intellectual property and related rights, and the entertainment company has not committed to taking over the whole platform. Character.AI's former CEO Karandeep Anand joined Disney as chief technology officer on October 2, with some technical staff moving with him; those departed employees are helping keep Character.AI running temporarily during the sale process.
updates.background_zh: Character.AI由Transformer论文作者之一Noam Shazeer与前谷歌研究员Daniel De Freitas创办；其应用在2023年上线不到一周便获得约170万次安装，公司完成1.5亿美元融资，估值达10亿美元。2024年，谷歌以27亿美元获得Character.AI大模型技术的非独家授权，并招走两位创始人及约20%的员工，此后Character.AI放弃与科技巨头竞争前沿大模型，转而专注聊天产品。此后平台因涉嫌伤害未成年人面临多起诉讼，搜索结果显示其在2026年1月与谷歌就五起相关诉讼达成和解。
updates.background_en: Character.AI was founded by Noam Shazeer, a co-author of the Transformer paper, and former Google researcher Daniel De Freitas; its app drew about 1.7 million installs within a week of its 2023 launch, and the company raised $150 million at a $1 billion valuation. In 2024, Google paid $2.7 billion for a non-exclusive license to Character.AI's model technology and hired the two founders plus roughly 20% of staff, after which Character.AI dropped frontier-model competition to focus on its chat product. The company later faced lawsuits over harm to minors, and search results indicate it agreed with Google in January 2026 to settle five such suits.

updates.title_zh: 迪士尼同意聘用Character.AI的大部分员工
updates.title_en: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce
updates.what_changed_zh: 在聊天机器人初创公司Character.AI申请破产后，迪士尼同意以2000万美元聘用其大部分员工并收购其部分资产。
updates.what_changed_en: Disney agreed to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce and acquire some of its assets for $20 million after the chatbot startup filed for bankruptcy.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Disney agreed to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce and acquire some of its assets for $20 million after the chatbot startup filed for bankruptcy.
updates.background_zh: Character.AI 是一项生成式 AI 聊天机器人服务，用户可与可自定义的角色对话；该公司由两名前谷歌员工创立，曾获 Andreessen Horowitz 领投的 1.5 亿美元融资，估值达 10 亿美元。2026 年 9 月，迪士尼宣布 Character.AI 时任首席执行官 Karandeep Anand 将出任公司新设立的首位首席技术官，自 10 月 2 日起生效。
updates.background_en: Character.AI is a generative AI chatbot service where users converse with customizable characters; it was founded by two former Google employees and raised $150 million led by Andreessen Horowitz at a $1 billion valuation. Disney announced in September 2026 that Karandeep Anand, formerly Character.AI's chief executive, would become its first chief technology officer, a newly created position, effective October 2.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该交易涉及一家私营 AI 初创公司与一家传统媒体公司，二者均无直接的加密资产敞口；其对数字资产市场的影响仅可能通过市场对 AI 相关代币的情绪传导，而非流动性、托管或供给渠道。
updates.market_impact_en: The transaction involves a private AI startup and a traditional media company with no direct crypto exposure; any effect on digital-asset markets would run only through sentiment toward AI-related tokens rather than through liquidity, custody or supply channels.

updates.title_zh: Character.AI破产细节曝光：迪士尼三年拟花1.8亿美元留人，平台只剩18人
updates.title_en: Character.AI破产细节曝光：迪士尼三年拟花1.8亿美元留人，平台只剩18人
updates.what_changed_zh: 破产法院文件显示，迪士尼已向Character.AI的66名员工发出工作邀请，预计三年投入约1.8亿美元（含3000万美元留任奖励），而对其部分技术和专利仅报价2000万美元；Character.AI申请破产时仅剩18名全职员工；40名州总检察长介入要求保护用户聊天记录；其他买家须在11月20日前提交竞购报价，否则平台可能关闭。
updates.what_changed_en: Bankruptcy court filings show Disney had offered jobs to 66 Character.AI employees, expecting to spend about $180 million over three years including $30 million in retention bonuses, while bidding only $20 million for perpetual non-exclusive rights to some technology and patents; Character.AI had only 18 full-time staff when it filed; 40 state attorneys general intervened to protect user chat records; other bidders must submit offers by November 20 or the platform may shut down.
updates.current_state_zh: Character.AI破产出售程序推进中：迪士尼拟以2000万美元获得部分技术/专利的永久非独占许可，并以约1.8亿美元三年成本接收66名员工；公司申请破产时仅剩18名全职员工，40名州总检察长介入保护用户聊天记录，11月20日为竞购截止日，若无人接盘平台将关闭。
updates.current_state_en: Character.AI’s bankruptcy sale process is advancing: Disney is poised to pay $20 million for perpetual non-exclusive rights to some technology and patents and to hire 66 employees at an expected cost of about $180 million over three years; the company had only 18 full-time staff at filing, 40 state attorneys general intervened to protect user chat records, and November 20 is the bid deadline, with shutdown possible if no buyer keeps the platform running.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Character.AI entered bankruptcy with only 18 full-time staff as Disney moved to hire 66 employees for about $180M over three years, while 40 state attorneys general intervened to protect user chat records ahead of a November 20 bid deadline that could lead to shutdown.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Character.AI entered bankruptcy with only 18 full-time staff as Disney moved to hire 66 employees for about $180M over three years, while 40 state attorneys general intervened to protect user chat records ahead of a November 20 bid deadline that could lead to shutdown.
